title: Silhouette with Neon Atom Awareness Day Post
whatItIs: An Instagram carousel slide on soft pink with a frosted glass frame around a dusky gradient circle holding a dark side-profile silhouette of a woman crossed by glowing lime atom orbits, and a centred two-tone caption 'International Day of Women and Girls in Science, February 11'.
whatItMeans: Neon orbits around a head turn an abstract idea into an emblem, and the pale pink frame keeps it gentle.
techniques: Silhouette wrapped by glowing orbit lines
Frosted rounded frame around the artwork
Pink field with one neon lime accent
Centred sentence-case caption with a dimmed date
Soft gradient circle behind the figure

vocabulary.definition: Elliptical strokes circling a subject like an atom model.
A translucent bordered panel around an image.
A date set in a lighter tone than the title.
